evidence_items.publisher: Zhang, Griffiths, Narasimhan and Press, via arXiv
evidence_items.explanation: VideoGameBench documents substantial difficulties in ten games. Its May models and whole-game objectives do not establish the status of rapid basic learning at the December deadline.

SIMA 2 demonstrates meaningful transfer to unfamiliar games, including ASKA and MineDojo. The study does not establish mastery and original-puzzle solving across almost any new game within the claimed learning window.

NitroGen broadens game-playing capability, but the report identifies limitations in planning and following language instructions. It does not supply the required timed, broad unfamiliar-game learning evaluation.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved evaluation jointly measures unfamiliar-game basics, original-puzzle solving, broad game coverage, and minutes-to-hours learning for the late-2025 frontier.
Whole-game completion is a stronger requirement than mastering basics.
Selected systems' limitations do not establish that every available system lacked the claimed capability.
